Messages.Author: Killiam
Messages.Body:
If I put Agent of Power on Seterpenre using his special text, do I get to name a discipline for him per the Agent of Power text?

(To onlookers: yes, I know that AoP burns during the discard phase, so there is no need to bring that up. It is irrelevant to my concern and my question.)

Thanks!
-Killiam (Bill Troxel)

Name: Agent of Power
[LotN:C, HttB:PSam4]
Cardtype: Master
Master: Discipline. Trifle. Unique.
Put this card on a vampire you control and choose a Discipline. This vampire gains 1 level of that Discipline. Burn this card during your discard phase.

Name: Seterpenre
[LotN:U]
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Follower of Set
Group: 5
Capacity: 10
Discipline: AUS NEC OBF PRE SER
Independent: When Seterpenre enters play, put up to four master: Discipline cards on him from your hand, ash heap and/or library (shuffle afterward). Discipline cards do not affect his capacity.

-Killiam
(Bill Troxel)  "I look back from where I'm from
Look at the woman I've become
And the strangest things seem
Suddenly routine"
-Hedwig Robinson

Messages.Author: Bloodartist
Messages.Body:
I don't see why not. It counts as a discipline card and you are expected to choose the discipline. Both use the word "put", so as far as I can see, all the requirements are filled.

Smoking craters tell no tales.
—Tex talks Battletech
